# Boston.com
> Boston.com is a regional news and lifestyle site covering Boston, New England, local sports, weather, culture, and events.

Boston.com publishes breaking news, in-depth local reporting, sports coverage, opinion, travel, food, and things to do across Greater Boston and New England. It also offers newsletters, event guides, and topic pages for major local teams and communities.

## News
- [News](https://www.boston.com/news/): Main news hub for Boston, Massachusetts, and New England reporting.
- [Local News](https://www.boston.com/news/local-news/): Coverage of Boston-area communities, public safety, transit, schools, and local government.
- [Crime](https://www.boston.com/news/crime/): Reporting on investigations, arrests, courts, and public safety incidents.
- [Politics](https://www.boston.com/news/politics/): Massachusetts and national political news affecting Boston-area readers.
- [Weather](https://www.boston.com/weather/): Forecasts, storm coverage, seasonal weather updates, and regional conditions.
- [National News](https://www.boston.com/news/national-news/): Major U.S. stories curated for Boston.com readers.
- [World News](https://www.boston.com/news/world-news/): International news coverage and global developments.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.boston.com/sports/): Central sports hub with coverage of Boston teams and major events.
- [New England Patriots](https://www.boston.com/sports/new-england-patriots/): News, analysis, game coverage, and roster updates for the Patriots.
- [Boston Red Sox](https://www.boston.com/sports/boston-red-sox/): Red Sox news, scores, trades, and season coverage.
- [Boston Celtics](https://www.boston.com/sports/boston-celtics/): Celtics reporting, game recaps, injuries, and playoff coverage.
- [Boston Bruins](https://www.boston.com/sports/boston-bruins/): Bruins news, analysis, and NHL season updates.
- [New England Revolution](https://www.boston.com/sports/new-england-revolution/): Coverage of the Revolution and regional soccer news.
- [Boston Marathon](https://www.boston.com/tag/boston-marathon/): News and features related to the Boston Marathon.
- [High School Sports](https://www.boston.com/sports/high-school-sports/): Coverage of local high school teams, athletes, and competitions.

## Lifestyle
- [Lifestyle](https://www.boston.com/lifestyle/): Lifestyle reporting on health, relationships, home, and everyday living.
- [Health](https://www.boston.com/lifestyle/health/): Health news, wellness reporting, and medical stories relevant to local readers.
- [Relationships](https://www.boston.com/lifestyle/relationships/): Advice, columns, and reporting on dating, family, and relationships.
- [Style](https://www.boston.com/lifestyle/style/): Fashion, beauty, and personal style coverage.
- [Home](https://www.boston.com/lifestyle/home/): Home design, real estate-adjacent living, and household features.
- [Parenting](https://www.boston.com/lifestyle/parenting/): Stories and advice for parents and families in the region.

## Food and Drink
- [Food](https://www.boston.com/food/): Restaurant news, dining guides, recipes, and local food coverage.
- [Restaurants](https://www.boston.com/food/restaurants/): Openings, closings, reviews, and restaurant industry news.
- [Drink](https://www.boston.com/food/drink/): Bars, cocktails, breweries, and beverage coverage.
- [Recipes](https://www.boston.com/food/recipes/): Recipe features and cooking inspiration from Boston.com.
- [Best of Boston Food](https://www.boston.com/tag/best-of-boston/): Roundups and recommendations featuring standout local places and experiences.

## Travel
- [Travel](https://www.boston.com/travel/): Travel news, destination ideas, and New England getaway coverage.
- [New England Travel](https://www.boston.com/travel/new-england-travel/): Regional trip ideas, seasonal escapes, and destination guides.
- [Hotels](https://www.boston.com/travel/hotels/): Hotel news, openings, and lodging recommendations.
- [Flights](https://www.boston.com/travel/flights/): Airline updates, airport news, and airfare-related reporting.
- [Road Trips](https://www.boston.com/tag/road-trips/): Road trip ideas and driving itineraries from Boston and New England.

## Things To Do
- [Things To Do](https://www.boston.com/things-to-do/): Guides to events, entertainment, and activities around Greater Boston.
- [Events](https://www.boston.com/events/): Event listings and coverage of concerts, festivals, and community happenings.
- [Arts](https://www.boston.com/culture/arts/): Coverage of visual arts, museums, and exhibitions.
- [Movies](https://www.boston.com/culture/movies/): Film news, reviews, and movie-related features.
- [Music](https://www.boston.com/culture/music/): Concert coverage, artist interviews, and local music reporting.
- [TV](https://www.boston.com/culture/tv/): Television news, reviews, and streaming-related stories.
- [Books](https://www.boston.com/culture/books/): Book coverage, author features, and literary news.

## Culture and Entertainment
- [Culture](https://www.boston.com/culture/): Entertainment and cultural reporting across Boston and beyond.
- [Celebrity](https://www.boston.com/culture/celebs/): Celebrity news and entertainment stories of interest to readers.
- [Theater](https://www.boston.com/culture/theater/): Theater reviews, productions, and performing arts coverage.
- [Comedy](https://www.boston.com/tag/comedy/): Comedy-related stories, performances, and local entertainment coverage.
- [Streaming](https://www.boston.com/tag/streaming/): Coverage of streaming shows, services, and viewing recommendations.

## Opinion and Columns
- [Opinion](https://www.boston.com/opinion/): Opinion pieces, editorials, and commentary on current issues.
- [Columns](https://www.boston.com/tag/columnists/): Columnist pages and recurring commentary from Boston.com contributors.
- [Love Letters](https://www.boston.com/tag/love-letters/): Meredith Goldstein’s advice column on dating and relationships.
- [Your Morning Read](https://www.boston.com/tag/your-morning-read/): Curated daily reading roundup and editor-selected links.

## Community and Local Guides
- [Boston Local News](https://www.boston.com/tag/boston/): Topic page for Boston-specific reporting and features.
- [Massachusetts](https://www.boston.com/tag/massachusetts/): Stories focused on statewide news and issues.
- [New England](https://www.boston.com/tag/new-england/): Regional reporting and features from across New England.
- [MBTA](https://www.boston.com/tag/mbta/): Coverage of Boston transit, service changes, and commuter issues.
- [Real Estate](https://www.boston.com/tag/real-estate/): Housing market, development, and property-related stories.
- [Education](https://www.boston.com/tag/education/): Reporting on schools, colleges, and education policy.

## Newsletters and Reader Services
- [Newsletter Sign-Up](https://www.boston.com/newsletter-signup): Sign up for Boston.com newsletters and recurring email updates.
- [Newsletters](https://www.boston.com/tag/newsletters/): Stories and announcements related to Boston.com newsletters.
- [Contact Us](https://www.boston.com/contact-us/): Contact information for editorial, tips, and general inquiries.
- [About Boston.com](https://www.boston.com/about/): Background information about Boston.com and its newsroom.
- [Archives](https://www.boston.com/tag/archive/): Access archived and historical Boston.com content by topic or tag.
